name: Dong Yang Steel Pipe Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Cheonan, South Korea, Dong Yang Steel Pipe Co., Ltd. has been a prominent manufacturer and distributor of steel pipes across the nation since its establishment in 1973. The company offers a wide array of specialized products, including extruded polyethylene-coated and polyurea-coated steel pipes primarily for water infrastructure. Additionally, it supplies sturdy steel pipes engineered for oil and gas transmission, along with coated and wrapped pipes for various water service applications, and essential steel pipe piles.
